rules.title: Table has no primary key
rules.detail: Without a primary key there is no way to address one row. A deduplication step has nothing to group on, a backfill UPDATE cannot be scoped, and a replica identity cannot be set — so the change that needs it fails later, on a table that already has production rows.
rules.fix: Add a primary key. If the table is deliberately key-less (a log or a staging table), say so in its comment and remove this rule for that table with a `select` clause.

fires: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGINT, paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ);
silent: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ);
CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGINT NOT NULL, paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ, PRIMARY KEY (id));
ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD CONSTRAINT pk_orders PRIMARY KEY (id);

rules.title: Table has no comment
rules.detail: A table with no comment is a bag of column names. This is where a model asked for "recent orders" picks the archive table: the schema says nothing about which one is live.
rules.fix: One line on what the table holds and whether it is live or archived.

fires: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY);
silent: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY); COMMENT ON TABLE shop.orders IS '订单主表 用途:支付事实 在线';

rules.title: Table comment does not state what the table is for
rules.detail: A comment that is a restatement of the name carries no information. What a reader — a person or a model — needs from it is the purpose and whether the rows are current.
rules.fix: Say what the table is for, and whether it is live or archived. Delete this rule if your project documents that elsewhere.

fires: CREATE TABLE t (id INT PRIMARY KEY); COMMENT ON TABLE t IS '订单主表';
CREATE TABLE t (id INT PRIMARY KEY); COMMENT ON TABLE t IS '订单主表 用途:支付事实';
silent: CREATE TABLE t (id INT PRIMARY KEY); COMMENT ON TABLE t IS '订单主表 用途:支付事实 在线';

rules.title: Column has no comment
rules.detail: Coded values, units and nullable fields stay invisible. A nullable key column with no comment reads as an ordinary key, and the join over it drops rows without an error.
rules.fix: Comment at least the status, type and nullable columns. Narrow `select` if some tables are documented elsewhere.

fires: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, channel TEXT);
silent: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, channel TEXT); COMMENT ON COLUMN shop.orders.id IS '主键'; COMMENT ON COLUMN shop.orders.channel IS '下单渠道 标准:CH-002';

rules.title: Column comment does not cite the data standard
rules.detail: A comment describes a column. A standard ID makes it governable: the value set, the unit and the owner live somewhere a reviewer can look up, and a comment that cites a standard can be checked against it instead of being taken on trust.
rules.fix: Add 标准：<ID> to the column comment, where ID names an entry in the project's data standard.

fires: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ); COMMENT ON COLUMN shop.orders.paid_at IS '支付时间';
silent: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ); COMMENT ON COLUMN shop.orders.paid_at IS '支付时间 标准:TS-004';
CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, channel TEXT); COMMENT ON COLUMN shop.orders.channel IS '渠道 Standard: CH-002';
